answer:
Domain is a rectangular tank 1.0 m (x) by 0.6 m (y) by 0.1 m (z), with the origin at the bottom-left corner (y=0 at the floor).
The mesh is 200 cells in x, 120 cells in y, and 1 cell in z, giving a uniform cell size of 0.005 m by 0.005 m by 0.1 m.
The simulation is 2D in the x-y plane: the front and back boundaries (z-faces) are marked as empty in constant/polyMesh/boundary.
The solver is interFoam with the Eulerian twoPhase mixture model.
Water has density 998 kg/m^3 and dynamic viscosity 0.001 Pa*s; air has density 1.2 kg/m^3 and dynamic viscosity 1.8e-5 Pa*s.
Surface tension coefficient sigma is 0.0728 N/m.
Gravity is set to (0, -9.81, 0) m/s^2 via the g vector in constant/g.
The bottom boundary at y=0 is a no-slip fixedWall for U, a fixedValue 0 for p_rgh, and a zeroGradient for alpha.water.
The left boundary at x=0 and the right boundary at x=1.0 are no-slip fixedWall for U, fixedValue 0 for p_rgh, and zeroGradient for alpha.water.
The top boundary at y=0.6 is an open atmospheric boundary: U uses pressureInletOutletVelocity, p_rgh uses totalPressure with p0 0, and alpha.water uses inletOutlet.
The initial velocity field U is zero everywhere.
The initial p_rgh field is zero everywhere.
The initial alpha.water field is 0 (air) everywhere by default, then setFields paints ten staircase boxes to create the tilted free surface.
Slice 0 covers x from 0.0 to 0.1 with water height 0.255 m; slice 1 covers x from 0.1 to 0.2 with height 0.265 m; slice 2 covers x from 0.2 to 0.3 with height 0.275 m; slice 3 covers x from 0.3 to 0.4 with height 0.285 m; slice 4 covers x from 0.4 to 0.5 with height 0.295 m; slice 5 covers x from 0.5 to 0.6 with height 0.305 m; slice 6 covers x from 0.6 to 0.7 with height 0.315 m; slice 7 covers x from 0.7 to 0.8 with height 0.325 m; slice 8 covers x from 0.8 to 0.9 with height 0.335 m; slice 9 covers x from 0.9 to 1.0 with height 0.345 m.
Each slice is defined as a boxToCell region in setFields with alpha.water set to 1 (water) and U set to (0,0,0).
The simulation is transient with endTime 10 s.
The initial time step deltaT is 1e-3 s, adjustTimeStep is yes, and maxCo is 0.5.
Results are written every 0.05 s (writeInterval 0.05).
No external forcing, acceleration field, or wall motion is applied; the only driving mechanism is the initial tilted free surface relaxing under gravity.
